title: 'Diablo':  A Classic Game Postmortem
summary: David Brevik's GDC 2016 postmortem of Diablo covers how it went from a turn-based claymation DOS concept to a real-time action RPG, plus the story of Blizzard North and development anecdotes.
why: Frequently recommended whenever Diablo or its origins come up, for its candid account of the human side of game development.

quote.text: heartily recommended if you want to know about the human aspect behind game dev
